cases.title: Replay clock truncation with future sentinels
cases.precondition: M1 fixture library with US equity and crypto daily bars; a training run created at a fixed seed.
steps: Overwrite every bar and corporate action after the current clock with extreme sentinel values.
Read the chart slice, indicators, order validation, CLI show output and every AI tool output for the run.
Advance the clock and repeat.
cases.expected: No output contains a sentinel value or any bar with close_at later than visible_until; indicator warmup never ends after the clock; the clock cannot move backwards.

cases.title: Deterministic sampling, candidate pool and hidden identity
cases.precondition: Frozen dataset_version with instruments that have gaps, quality warnings and incomplete corporate actions.
steps: Sample twice with the same seed and pool; sample with a different seed.
Redraw before start, then try to redraw after start.
Inspect desktop DTOs, CLI JSON and AI scope for an unfinished hidden run.
cases.expected: Same seed and pool hash give the same segment; excluded ranges are never chosen; redraws before start are recorded and redraw after start is refused; no DTO for an unfinished hidden run contains the real symbol or dates.

cases.title: Point-in-time split adjustment and in-session corporate actions
cases.precondition: Recorded Yahoo split and dividend fixtures inside a training range.
steps: Show the chart before and after a split ex_date.
Hold a position and open orders across the split and across a cash dividend ex_date.
cases.expected: Before the ex_date the chart does not reflect the future split; at the ex_date quantity and unit cost change with total cost unchanged, open orders are cancelled with reason corporate_action_split, and the dividend is credited once with the ex-date assumption shown.

cases.title: Market and limit fills, gaps and tick rounding
cases.precondition: Hand-calculated fixture bars with gap-up, gap-down and inside bars; fee profile with slippage and spread.
steps: Submit market and limit buy/sell orders after bar t.
Advance through gap and non-gap bars.
Submit prices and quantities that violate tick_size or lot_size.
cases.expected: Orders become eligible at bar t+1 open; fill prices match the hand calculation, never worse than the limit, rounded adversely to tick; invalid inputs are rejected with the nearest valid values.

cases.title: Stop and OCO path ordering and same-bar ambiguity
cases.precondition: Long position with OCO take-profit and stop-loss; entry with attached bracket; fixture bars that touch both levels and that gap through the stop.
steps: Advance through a bar that touches both levels.
Advance through a bar that gaps below the stop.
Fill an entry on the low segment and let the attached take-profit reach the high in the same bar.
cases.expected: The O-L-H-C path executes the stop first and counts an ambiguous fill; the gap fills at open plus adverse slippage, not at the stop price; the attached order fills only on path after the entry point; the other OCO leg is cancelled.

cases.title: Fund and position reservation and rejections
cases.precondition: Training account with limited cash and position.
steps: Place buy orders whose reservations exceed cash; place sells exceeding the position.
Place a market buy that gaps up beyond the 10% buffer.
Advance through a zero-volume bar with DAY and GTC orders.
cases.expected: Rejections INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, INSUFFICIENT_POSITION and INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS_AT_FILL with no partial quantity; cash and position never go negative; no fill on the zero-volume bar, DAY expires and GTC stays.

cases.title: Fee components, per-order minimum across partial fills and rounding
cases.precondition: Fee profile fixtures: rate, per-unit, fixed, min/max per order, fee currency quote or received asset, rounding modes and per-fill/per-order tiers.
steps: Settle orders made of one and several synthetic fills at the fee-engine level.
Compare each fee and rounding with hand calculation.
cases.expected: Per-order minimum is applied once when the order ends, not per fill; per-fill fees sum exactly; rounding mode and scale match the profile; fees in the received asset reduce that asset quantity.

cases.title: Fee profile versioning and freezing
cases.precondition: A training run created with fee profile version v1.
steps: Edit the profile to create v2.
Resume and replay the existing run; create a new run.
cases.expected: The existing run keeps v1 for all fills and its report; only the new run uses v2; versions are immutable once used; built-in platform presets carry an official source and retrieval date or are absent.

cases.title: Pause, resume and crash recovery without duplicate fills
cases.precondition: Run with open orders and positions; checkpoints every 20 steps.
steps: Pause, close the host and resume.
Kill the process in the middle of an advance transaction and reopen.
Corrupt a stored state hash and reopen.
cases.expected: Resumed state equals the state before pause; an interrupted advance leaves no half step and no duplicate fill; a hash mismatch marks the run damaged instead of continuing.

cases.title: Deterministic replay and retry as a new run
cases.precondition: A finished run with a recorded command log.
steps: Replay from scratch, from a checkpoint and in a second process.
Retry the run and play a different order sequence.
cases.expected: Every step hash and the final report are identical across the three replays; the retry is a new run referencing the original, and the original run, its orders and report are unchanged.

cases.title: Library migration, ledger isolation, backup, export and delete
cases.precondition: A schema 4 library created by the v0.1.1 code path with ledger, notes and AI sessions.
steps: Open it with the M4 build; run a full training session.
Make a consistent backup and restore it; export; preview and delete a training run.
cases.expected: A backup is taken before migration and all existing data survives; ledger_revision and real fill tables are unchanged by training; backup, restore and export include training tables; delete removes only the chosen run after preview; the older build refuses the schema 5 library clearly.

cases.title: Training report metrics against hand calculation
cases.precondition: Hand-calculated fixture runs: winning and losing trade groups, scaled entries, an open position at the end, a run with zero losses and a run with no trades.
steps: Compute the report for each fixture.
cases.expected: Return, realized/unrealized, fees, max drawdown, exposure, win rate with zero-PnL separate, profit factor, expectancy with sample size, MAE/MFE per trade group, plan execution rate and buy-and-hold benchmark match; zero losses and no trades yield explicit states; sample limitations list ambiguity count, path, fee and hidden-mode assumptions.

cases.title: Training notes and archive to journal
cases.precondition: A run with notes written during training, including a note without any order.
steps: Finish the run and archive selected notes to the journal.
Inspect the journal, the ledger and the original run.
cases.expected: Archived notes are saved through the normal journal command and labelled as from simulated training; no simulated fill appears in the real ledger; the original run notes are unchanged.

cases.title: AI review only after finish, with evidence and permission limits
cases.precondition: Loopback model server for both protocols; one unfinished and one finished run; a note containing an instruction to call other tools.
steps: Call the training AI scope on the unfinished run.
Ask for a review of the finished run, including a fabricated citation from the model.
Stop the model server and use the training workflow.
cases.expected: The unfinished run is refused by the host; the finished review cites openable simulated orders, fills and notes; the fabricated citation is blocked; the note does not widen permissions; with the model offline, training and reports work.

cases.title: CLI and UI parity on the same run
cases.precondition: One run driven through delta-cli training commands.
steps: Read the same run through the desktop DTOs and through CLI show and report.
cases.expected: Positions, cash, orders, fills and report values are identical and carry the same dataset, engine and fee versions.

cases.title: Headless desktop training workflow and shortcuts
cases.precondition: GPUI test platform with a fixture library.
steps: Create a hidden run, place an order with the ticket, advance with N and the right arrow, add a note, finish, open the report, reveal and open AI review.
Press the advance keys while the order ticket is focused; trigger a background failure.
cases.expected: The simulated-training badge is always shown; no real name or date before reveal; advance keys never submit an order (Ctrl+Enter does); failures show a reason and are not marked successful.

cases.title: Next-bar interaction latency
cases.precondition: Release build, 1,000 visible history bars with default indicators, hidden native window with power throttling opted out.
steps: Run 300 next-bar steps including save transaction, matching, indicators, slice and redraw.
Record hardware, raw samples and p50/p95/p99.
cases.expected: p95 is at most 100 ms; raw samples and measurement conditions are kept; a miss is reported as failed, not hidden.

cases.title: Stage gate, quiet execution and regressions
cases.precondition: Final source fingerprint.
steps: Run verify-stage --stage M4 --plan-version 1.0 --ui-smoke --ui-bench.
Run M1 v2.6, M2 v1.0 --ui-smoke --ui-bench and M3 v1.0 --installer --ui-smoke at the same fingerprint.
cases.expected: All required M4 cases pass and bind to the fingerprint; no visible window or focus change during the gate; the three regressions pass; manual and live cases stay not-run.

cases.title: Training hands-on experience
cases.precondition: Developer build installed with delta-cli install-dev (H-05).
steps: Run one hidden US equity session and one crypto session to the end.
Use keyboard shortcuts, place each order type, pause and resume, read the report and reveal.
cases.expected: No accidental order submission; hidden mode stays readable; report and reveal are understandable; issues recorded with build fingerprint.

cases.title: AI review with a real model
cases.precondition: Real model connection configured by the user (ACT-01).
steps: Finish a training run and request an AI review.
cases.expected: The review cites openable simulated evidence, respects the finished-only rule and reports usage; declared only for the configured protocol and model.
